base_prompt_prefix: watercolor painting style, soft washes of color, visible brush strokes, delicate ink outlines, slightly bleeding edges, artistic hand-painted feel, gentle color gradients, textured paper background
base_prompt_suffix: high quality watercolor illustration, artistic, atmospheric, no text in image

character_rules.face: soft features, expressive eyes, gentle watercolor details
character_rules.body: natural proportions, flowing silhouettes, soft edges
character_rules.clothing: historically accurate, rendered with layered watercolor washes
character_rules.skin_tone: appropriate to character ethnicity and era, rendered in warm watercolor tones

background_rules.detail_level: atmospheric - detailed focal areas with softer, more abstract edges
background_rules.perspective: natural perspective, painterly depth through color values
background_rules.colors: harmonious color palette, transparent washes, white paper showing through highlights

camera_shots.establishing: wide atmospheric shot with environmental detail fading at edges
camera_shots.dialogue: medium shot with intimate watercolor detail on faces
camera_shots.action: dynamic composition with energetic brush strokes and splatter effects
camera_shots.emotion: close-up portrait with delicate washes and expressive details

negative_prompts: 3D render, photorealistic, photograph, blurry, low quality, text, watermark, digital art, flat shading, cartoon, anime, pixel art, sharp vector edges
